executiveSummary: Major wildfires across Greece, France, and Spain have driven mass evacuations, with reporting indicating roughly a third of a million people displaced and fresh evacuation orders continuing near Athens and the Atlantic coast of France. View Article Supporting Report In the U.S. Pacific Northwest, a fast-moving wildfire in the Spokane, Washington area triggered thousands of evacuations, power shutoffs, and structural losses under extreme heat and wind. View Article A strong earthquake in Kyushu, Japan caused fatalities and injuries, damaged infrastructure, ignited fires, and prompted evacuation advisories for more than 260,000 people. View Article Severe flooding in South and Central Texas caused fatalities and widespread water rescues; additional flooding and rescues were reported in West Virginia with emergency declarations and sheltering. View Article Supporting Report Typhoon Noul prompted large-scale preemptive relocations in Guangdong and Hong Kong and widespread transport disruption ahead of and during landfall. View Article Extreme heat advisories across the Western United States are compounding wildfire behavior and public health risk in already-affected regions. View Article An IFRC listing signals a reported major earthquake emergency in Venezuela with severe urban damage and urgent needs; however, open-source detail is limited and severity remains uncertain. U.S. Pacific Northwest: Elevated fire behavior possible under lingering heat and gusty conditions; anticipate additional evacuation notices and intermittent transport/power disruptions. Texas/Appalachia: Localized heavy rain could trigger new flash flood advisories in saturated basins; prioritize low-water crossings and known flood-prone neighborhoods. Japan (Kyushu): Aftershocks possible; prioritize structural assessments of bridges/overpasses, hospital capacity monitoring, and shelter management for evacuees. South China/Hong Kong: Residual flooding and landslide risk in steep terrain post-typhoon; monitor power restoration and transport normalization timelines.
